Chapter 1123: 39: Visitors From The Capital (Subscription Requested)_2

Chapter 1123: Chapter 39: Visitors from the Capital (Subscription Requested)_2

Previously, by continually comprehending the Chaos Secret Patterns, I enhanced my perception of the Chaos Rule, which also drove my understanding of thousands of other rules like the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

Therefore, in the pursuit and assassination aspect, unless those royal family members who are skilled at these techniques, no one can escape Lin Yuan.

“Galaxy, you want to capture me?”

The Spirit Might King sensed Lin Yuan’s aura approaching, so he simply stopped running and stood silently on the spot.

“Impossible.”

The Spirit Might King shook his head, and immediately his physical body and soul began to perish.

Other Great Lords can be captured and then have the Da Ling Ancient Country ransom them back.

But he, the Spirit Might King, cannot do such a thing.

This is not about ‘ransom’,

but as Da Ling royalty, becoming a prisoner of war to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country?

This would be a disgrace to the Da Ling Ancient Country.

Therefore.

Upon realizing he couldn’t escape, the Spirit Might King decisively chose to obliterate this physical body.

Compared to losing all face as a prisoner of war, the Spirit Might King would rather abandon this physical body.

Lin Yuan saw this, feeling slightly regretful, but he had expected it.

The reason he didn’t spare the King Lingshen but directly killed him was because he felt the opponent was impossible to suppress.

Upon realizing he wasn’t Lin Yuan’s opponent, the King Lingshen would surely choose to end himself as well.

This is also the only thing the ancient country’s royalty can do.

“Quite a few treasures.”

Lin Yuan continued to collect the Spirit Might King’s remaining treasures, though not as rich as King Lingshen, but quite affluent among the Great Lords.

“This time, taking action….”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face, considering the wealth carried by the royal families such as King Lingshen and Spirit Might King, and the treasures and rare items of dozens of Great Lords.

For those dozens of Great Lords, while Lin Yuan had the idea of exchanging them for ‘ransom’, he definitely would take the many treasures and weapons they carried before bargaining.

After tallying them briefly, Lin Yuan found he was already enormously profited.

Furthermore, besides those trophies acquired from the enemies’ hands.

Lin Yuan could also use the meritorious service obtained on the battlefield to exchange treasures from the Red Pine King.

And with Lin Yuan’s recent performance, nearly overturning the battle situation single-handedly, how significant would the meritorious service be?

…

Da Ling Ancient Country.

In a certain mansion within the capital.

Deep within layers of formation prohibitions, a piece of white crystal stone suddenly emitted a faint glow, and then a figure coalesced, it was the King Lingshen.

The resurrected King Lingshen using life-saving means appeared extremely weak.

However, compared to physical and soul weakness, the King Lingshen was also greatly troubled mentally.

“Did I really die?”

“Noble, dying at the hands of a life under a Heavenly Venerate?”

The King Lingshen murmured, feeling sure Lin Yuan was definitely not a Heavenly Venerate, at most like him, a core royalty of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country at their limit.

The core royalty reaching their limit, their combat power being virtually invincible among the Great Lords, even facing fellow core royalty at the same level, unable to achieve victory, but also hard to perish, let alone being directly slain.

“Was it because… my Bloodline Talent was restrained by that Galaxy?”

The King Lingshen began to retrospect, flashes of combat scenes crossing his mind.

He employed the strongest killing move, merging into the ‘Spirit’ of all things, but in the end, that Galaxy used some method unknown to him, reached the ultimate control over the surrounding world and space, even reverse controlling the ‘Spirit’ of all things.

This was also the key to King Lingshen’s downfall; after merging into ‘Spirit’, he was nearly in an undefeated position, but similarly lost many other techniques.

Added to breaking out of the merged ‘Spirit’ state and being mentally shocked, that’s how he was so easily killed by Galaxy.

“If I hadn’t utilized transforming into ‘Spirit’ this killing move, maybe I could’ve held on a bit longer.”

The King Lingshen mused silently.

Yes.

Just held on a bit longer.

Although the King Lingshen realized he was restrained by Galaxy, that ultimate control power seeming almost above everything, even if he hadn’t transformed into ‘Spirit’, the outcome wouldn’t be different.

At most he could hold on a bit longer.

Buy withdrawal time for those Great Lords of the Da Ling Ancient Country?

“Galaxy… could it be that the core royalty of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country made progress in breaking through the shackles of the Celestial race? That’s why Galaxy possessed such combat power?”

The King Lingshen calmed his mind, speculating inwardly.

Lin Yuan’s power clearly exceeded normal limits, surpassing core royalty by a large margin, yet not crossing into the Celestial race.

That’s why the King Lingshen harbored this suspicion.

“This could also be a good thing.”

“It indicates that once we core royalty reach the limit, it’s not a roadblock ahead, there’s still potential for further improvement.”

The King Lingshen had a burning look in his eyes, compared to his own defeat, discovering that the path ahead could still be taken would be of greater help to him.

…

Swish.

Lin Yuan put away the spoils from the Spirit Might King, his figure vanished, returning once more to the battlefield.

“Senior Galaxy.” At this moment, King Chijue stepped forward excitedly, expressing his gratitude: “I never expected you to pass by here and lend a helping hand. If not for you this time, dozens of surrounding domains would likely have fallen.”

“It’s nothing.” Lin Yuan looked at King Chijue, immediately understanding his meaning.

King Chijue must have taken him for a core member of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country who had grown to the limit.

After all, Lin Yuan’s power was evident, further enhanced by the methods involving the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

If Lin Yuan wasn’t an ultimate core royal, even King Chijue wouldn’t believe it.

Lin Yuan did not deny it, as this could indeed explain his current level of strength.

“Senior Galaxy.” At this moment, the Red Pine King also came over, his tone apologetic, saying: “Earlier I didn’t know your identity, so I spoke in that manner. I hope you can forgive me, forgive me!”

Lin Yuan had defeated the Thunder Spear Great Honored, and the Red Pine King had personally summoned Lin Yuan, the two had exchanged a few words.

In fact, the Red Pine King’s attitude back then was quite cordial, without displaying any kingly demeanor, but once considering Lin Yuan’s identity, the Red Pine King felt somewhat uneasy.

“No need to say such things.”

Lin Yuan didn’t care much.

“What should we do next?”

“Invade the Purple Dream Domain?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the two royal Great Lords and said casually.

Now, all the Great Lords from the Purple Dream Domain and dozens of surrounding domains had been suppressed by Lin Yuan, rendering the enemy’s dozens of domains as mere empty shells.

As long as the Red Pine King was willing to attack, there would definitely be little resistance faced.

“Invade the Purple Dream Domain?”

The Red Pine King hesitated slightly, then shook his head and said: “Let’s forget it, with the fall of the King Lingshen, the Da Ling Ancient Country will certainly take action, attacking the Purple Dream Domain now, even if we can capture it, it will be hard to defend, there’s no need for this.”

The Red Pine King had little ambition; he sought no merits but avoided mistakes.

Merely preserving the Qingfen Domain was sufficient.

“Fair enough.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Red Pine King’s considerations were not unreasonable.

…

In the distance.

More than twenty Great Lords looked at each other, the scene of Lin Yuan battling the King Lingshen earlier had truly left them in shock.

Originally thought to be a fierce fight, in the end, the King Lingshen did not last long.

“Senior Galaxy’s power…”

The Fire Axe Great Venerable looked shocked, and the Great Venerate Hongye was no better off.

Especially the Great Venerate Hongye, who prior had quite a good relationship with Lin Yuan, never even considered this newly advanced Great Lord to be a core royal grown to the limit.

Especially given Lin Yuan’s displayed strength, it clearly wasn’t just about having grown to the limit as a core royal.

…

Qingfen City.

The area of the teleportation formation.

Currently, the largest teleportation formation suddenly lit up, and after dozens of breaths, several figures emerged.

These figures, led by an old man with a red beard, followed by three or four young men and women.

“The King Lingshen of the Da Ling Ancient Country has indeed grown to the limit, amazing.”

A young man spoke, glancing around and slightly relaxing, “It seems we arrived in time.”

Currently, there was no major issue at Qingfen City, and the teleportation formation was operating smoothly, indicating that the King Lingshen hadn’t yet acted against Qingfen City.

Thus, it wasn’t in vain for them to come.

These figures were the support sent by the capital of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country upon learning that the King Lingshen’s power exceeded expectations.

The three or four young men were all royal subjects at the Great Lord level, and the leading old man with the red beard was a core royal who had grown to the limit.

In the entire Fierce Sun Ancient Country, core royals were scarce, and those who had grown to the limit even scarcer.

The red-bearded old man had arrived so quickly, indicating he highly valued the war between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain.

“Hm?”

The red-bearded old man’s gaze was slightly different as he looked towards the battlefield.

“What’s wrong?” Three or four young men watched the red-bearded old man stand still, showing no intention of rushing to the battlefield, feeling anxious.

Although they didn’t know what King Chijue and the Red Pine King relied upon to hold off a core royal grown to the limit like the King Lingshen for so long.

But clearly the sooner they get over there the better.

“Don’t worry.”

The red-bearded old man glanced at the young men, and with some confusion, said: “The war is already over.”
